reportedIssues: The pizza card shows a '-100%' badge. This implies the item is completely free, which is almost certainly a data or formatting error (a wrong discount value) and could mislead users.

The secondary gray text (delivery fees under the 'Fastest near you' cards, the '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen' line, and the '(500+)' rating count) has low contrast against the white background. The search placeholder is also light gray on light gray.

The white time pills (e.g. '15–25 min') sit over the food images and overlap the image edge, so they look cramped. The white '€0 delivery' and '-100%' badges are small, and the dark heart icon buttons have weak contrast over the busy imagery.

The illustrated food images are inconsistent. The poke bowl card has a light background while the others are dark, and the images are flat vector art rather than real photos, so the cards look uneven.

The badge styles are inconsistent. '€0 delivery' uses green text on a white pill, and the '-100%' badge uses the same style even though it carries a different kind of information. The pizza card also lacks the rating and info shown on other cards.
